note: The session's web search allowance ran out after fourteen searches (the judges, the statewide candidate and the legislative candidates), so the city council candidate and the fifteen school board candidates were not searched for at all, and neither were campaign websites for Roger Victory, Larry Johnson, Kristina S. Lyke, Michael Huber, Alabas Farhat or John Damoose. This machine's address lookups failed repeatedly for danpelchat.com, gp.org (the Green Party's 2026 candidate list, for Jahdante John Elijah Smith) and whtc.com; the state's press-release pages refused scripts (403). Mark J. Plawecki's birth date is on Wikipedia without a citation, so it is left out. Patrick Duvendeck's 2024 run was seen only on voter-guide sites, not on a record, so it is left out. Dan Pelchat's website could not be opened from here: two other pages name it, and a verifier must open it or delete it. A blank means not looked up or not found, not that nothing exists.
